title: Nazi flying saucers attempted but not achieved

tellings.quote: they I think they certainly tried I mean there's you know the experiments DEA which were which were now known and other ones and they're Foo Fighters over Bavaria but in reality they they did not have the technology

plain: A researcher named Lue Elizondo says the Nazis in World War II certainly tried to build flying saucers, pointing to experiments and to the foo fighters, strange lights that pilots reported, over Bavaria in southern Germany. But in his view they did not actually have the technology. He says it on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, to argue that German wartime projects do not explain UFOs.
